title: Attio signals split
description: A dark split band: on the left a navy badge, a two-tone 40px heading and a small arrow button over three tabs that take turns on a six-second timer, the active one opening with a grey line and a hairline progress rule that fills left to right; on the right a tall art panel that swaps with a soft blur-fade. On phones it centres, with three rules side by side and the active line beneath.
notes: forces the dark palette and marks itself data-header-tone="dark" for the attio header
the art is a media slot (695×808 on desktop, square on phones), per tab or shared; empty, a faint glow placeholder
with reduced motion the tabs don't advance on their own
